<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/resource-types/{type}/resources"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Paginated query for resources of a given type. 

Only the filter conditions declared in query.filters of the resource type definition are allowed; passing undeclared query parameters will result in a 400 error.

parentId is only valid for hierarchical resources that declare this filter.

protocolId is only applicable to protocol resources.

page defaults to 1.

pageSize defaults to 20, maximum is 100.

sort format must be `field:asc` or `field:desc`. The field must be in query.sortable; defaults to id:asc if not provided.

Paginated results do not include total. Use hasMore to indicate whether there are more pages. You can use GET /resource-types/\{type\} to get the current runtime rules.

protocol.network/device/point list items return a read-only protocolId; protocol devices and points return business deviceId according to visibility and permissions. Points include control reference state and full reference when available. Discovery candidates carry protocolId/jobId. New Resource jobs preserve owner context.

When querying with `type=sequence`:
- If `deviceId` is not passed, returns the user's custom sequence library.
- If `deviceId` is provided, only returns scenarios already assigned to this device (user-configured, device presets, built-in); items already belonging to the device include `properties.assignment`.
- If `includeAssignable=true`, additionally returns user scenarios that are not yet assigned but abilities match (no `properties.assignment`). If omitted or `false`, will not include assignable scenarios. This parameter is ignored if `deviceId` is not provided.
- Built-in scenarios' `properties.name` and `properties.labelTypeName` are localized according to the `Lang` request header.
- When passing `deviceId`, the response under data echoes `deviceId` and this device's `spec` (data.deviceId/data.spec).

You can use [GET /resource-types/\{type\}](https://docs.aqara.com/docs/aqara-developer/data-export-api/describe-resource-type) to get the definition of the query target resource type.
